# Libertify

> Libertify is an AI document-to-video platform that transforms documents, slides, and SOPs into professional, engaging videos with interactive chatbots and analytics.

Libertify serves enterprises, HR teams, sales organizations, and job seekers by automating the conversion of static documents (PDFs, PowerPoint, Google Slides, Word) into dynamic video content. The platform includes interactive resume builders, ROI calculators, and engagement tracking to measure impact across organizations.

## Key Topics

- AI document-to-video transformation
- Interactive chatbots
- Video storytelling
- Engagement analytics
- SOP automation
- Enterprise security (SOC 2, ISO27001)
- PDF/PowerPoint/Google Slides conversion
- ROI measurement
- Smart Journey Engine
- Interactive resume builder
- Document-to-video use cases
- Video explainers
- SaaS platform
- AI Ready Media
- Engagement metrics

## Tools & Calculators

- [ROI Simulators — Calculate AI Video Impact](https://www.libertify.com/roi-simulators): Interactive ROI calculator estimating time savings and engagement impact
- [Libertify ROI Simulator](https://www.libertify.com/fit-score-simulator): ROI simulator tool scoring documents and projecting savings across pricing tiers
- [Document Health Check](https://www.libertify.com/whats-wrong-with-my-documents): Free document audit analyzing readability, engagement potential, and optimization gaps
